scientific_limitations: Exact Frobenius projection is proved for zero-one partial-permutation vertices, not arbitrary fractional substochastic matrices.
The full-polytope statement is the Hausdorff distance and its unique farthest point, not a projection formula for all fractional inputs.
The Gaussian rank-deficiency limit is an acknowledged prior probabilistic result; the new contribution is its metric interpretation using the exact projection formula.
Historical priority remains provisional; some older matrix-nearness literature was inspected through abstract rather than full text.
